Device data

Each device includes 10 MB written per month, kept for 42 days. Extra writes are $0.10 per GB and storage is $0.05 per GB-month. Logs count as device data. Reading data back is free.

Questions

Are network fees included?

Yes. Your price includes the network fees for your chosen settings. There are no separate usage bills.

How are prices set?

Each price starts from our list price and never goes below it. We check it against current network costs, the SUI price and the network gas price, so every plan keeps a margin even if those costs rise sharply. If network costs rise far enough, prices for new quotes go up. Prices shown reflect network costs as of 2026-10-23.

Can I change my configuration later?

Yes. Settings are chosen per fleet and can be changed any time. The console shows the new price before you approve the change.

Will my price change if network costs change?

Not during your term: prices are fixed in US dollars and never change mid-term. When a prepaid annual invoice is paid, we buy 100% of the SUI the term is expected to use, which protects against token-price rises. If the cost of network operations at renewal is at least 3× what your quote assumed, we send a new quote at least 30 days in advance.
